name: crew-board
description: Shows session helpers above the prompt by scanning the machine's process list with ps and lsof, reading helper logs for progress, writing stall markers under ~/.claude/crew-board/, and injecting a stall note into session context.

showElsewhere.title: Show helpers elsewhere
showElsewhere.description: Discover detached helpers and helpers from other Claude windows on this machine.

maxAgeSeconds.title: Worker maximum age
maxAgeSeconds.description: Expire workers with no observed completion after this many seconds.

stallMinutes.title: Helper stall timeout
stallMinutes.description: Warn when a running external helper writes no new output for this many minutes.
